result:
The blog now supports English and Japanese, with a language switcher in the header on every page. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass, and `guren check --i18n` reports full key parity (27 keys in each language). I didn't boot the app or check the Japanese `_i18n.locale` on a rendered page. My new test only covers the `POST /locale` redirect, cookie and rejection cases.

- **`POST /locale`:** It takes `{ locale }` and is open to guests and signed-in users. It sets a `locale` cookie for a year and redirects with a 303 to the path of the `Referer`, or to `/` if there is none. Only the path and query are used, so a foreign `Referer` can't become an open redirect.
- **Invalid values:** Anything other than `en` or `ja`, or a missing field, returns a 422 like an invalid post title and leaves the current choice unchanged.
- **Browser detection:** The app now lists `ja` as supported in `src/app.ts`, so Guren's locale detection handles the rest. A saved pick wins over `Accept-Language`, and `Accept-Language: ja` alone gives Japanese on a first visit.
- **Catalogs:** `lang/en/` and `lang/ja/` have matching `nav.json`, `auth.json` and `posts.json`, plus a Japanese `messages.json` that keeps the existing `welcome` key. All nine required keys are there with the Japanese values from your table.
- **Pages:** `Layout.tsx` now reads the header labels from the catalog and has the English / 日本語 switcher; it also gains a Home link (`nav.home`). The posts pages (list, post, new, edit) read their labels through `useTranslation()`. No page spells out 「記事」.

The Japanese `posts.title` (the posts list heading and page title) is 記事一覧, which differs from the header link's 記事. I did that so the heading reads naturally, but say if you want them identical.

The new code is in `app/Http/Controllers/LocaleController.ts` and `app/Http/Validators/LocaleValidator.ts`, with the route in `routes/web.ts` and the test in `tests/LocaleController.test.ts`. Rerunning codegen also regenerated `.guren/routes.gen.ts`, `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` and `.guren/translations.gen.ts`.
